kata.name: probe naturality floor control: the a3→w3 sync defect distinguish already catches — zero unique detections
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: the floor control must self-negate — distinguish already catches the sync defect, so the naturality probe buys no unique detection

expected.detail: floor control — the crm/warehouse `a3→w3` sync defect is already detected by the executed `distinguish` baseline (it reports the pair distinguishable on `account#2`, left=1, right=0); the naturality probe must show zero unique detections here (design Decision 5)

the same `a3→w3` fault: `distinguish` answers "instances differ" on `account#2` but never says which claimed mapping cell is incoherent; naturality names arrow `account_owner` and source row `account#2`. Detection is parity (both arms fire), so the uniqueness axis derives `killed`; the wrong-question gap is the recorded contribution and no unique detection is claimed

commands: cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- naturality fixtures/probes/naturality/crm.ct.json fixtures/probes/naturality/warehouse_break.ct.json --json  # exit 3, one violation/executed

cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- naturality fixtures/probes/naturality/crm.ct.json fixtures/probes/naturality/warehouse_break.ct.json  # exit 3; human: violation: naturality of account_owner / at row account#2: lhs=owner#1 rhs=owner#0

cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- distinguish fixtures/probes/naturality/crm.ct.json fixtures/probes/naturality/warehouse_break.ct.json --observe account_owner@account#2 --json  # exit 0, outcome distinguishable (left=1, right=0)

comparison.conventional_baseline: The executed `distinguish` arm reports that the two instances differ on account#2 (left=1, right=0). It cannot report which claimed mapping cell is incoherent: it answers 'instances differ', not 'this map cell is incoherent'.

procedure: 1. The fault set and its expectations were committed in fixtures/probes/naturality/faults.json and crates/catherine-ledger/src/catalog.rs before any run; nothing here is edited after the run.
2. The baseline arm (`catherine distinguish`, revision 79cef70) was executed first on the same pair: `--observe account_owner@account#2` reports outcome distinguishable with left=1 and right=0.
3. The probe arm ran `catherine naturality` on the same pair: exit 3 with one violation/executed witness {arrow: account_owner, source_row: 2, lhs: 1, rhs: 0}.
4. Elements were compared at fault level: both arms detect the a3→w3 sync defect, so unique_detections is empty.

5. The uniqueness axis derives killed for an empty unique set: both arms detect the a3→w3 sync defect, so the non-control entry records killed (the honest null result: parity on detections) with the wrong-question gap, because the probe's contribution is a correct witness (which cell is incoherent), not a unique detection. The null detection result is recorded, never suppressed.
